title: AI made finding vulnerabilities easier. Patching didn't get faster
h1: AI made finding vulnerabilities easier. Patching didn’t get faster

cover.alt: A crack runs through a grid, with a closed lock beside it

tldr: Finding a serious hole in software used to be expensive. AI is driving that cost down. And both sides are taking advantage of it. If vulnerabilities start getting found faster than they get closed, the window of risk grows.
